name: Ravinder Sidhu
review: Nice people, great experience, and they do work very fast and at a good price. I had a bad sound in my truck and other shops quoted almost $3,000 to $4,000, but someone recommended Imperial Truck to me. They did the job very well at a great price. Highly recommended!

name: Amritpal Singh (Amrit Dhillon)
review: This place is my favorite place now. They are better than other service shops. Mr. Singh is always the best person to deal with for any service work, always welcoming with a great sense of humor. Fast, hard-working team. Imperial is always my first choice!

name: Alexandr Zagorceanu
review: Best service in Manteca, CA! Fast, reliable, and easy. Had an issue with TC lights on my semi-truck that they diagnosed, fixed in 20 minutes, and road tested. Thanks for bringing me back to the road so quickly. 5 stars!

name: Patti n Pups
review: My high-top van is too big for regular carwashes. So happy to find these guys! Reasonable price for my huge van and I didn't even have to get out. 3 years later, I am just as satisfied with their work. The crew is fantastic!

name: Ike Mor
review: Super friendly staff, prompt service, fair price, and even a pot of warm chai while we waited. Gave us valuable road advice and we left with a big smile. Outstanding customer care!
